translations.《生产级多智能体系统》第 04 章架构图，使用确定性白板线框表达控制流、证据或责: Chapter 04 architecture diagrams for Production-Grade Multi-Agent Systems, using deterministic whiteboard wireframes to show control flow and evidence or responsibility boundaries.
translations.① 相关：服务当前任务: ① Relevant: serves the current task
translations.② 授权：用户和用途允许: ② Authorized: user and purpose permitted
translations.⑥ 可评测：可保存与重放: ⑥ Evaluable: can be saved and replayed
translations.从 Source Manifest 到 Claim-Citation，每一层都有: From Source Manifest to Claim-Citation, every layer carries version, permissions, temporal state, and Trace.
translations.分类不是为了贴标签，而是为了明确来源、Owner、生命周期和进入模型的规则。: Classification is not about labels; it makes source, Owner, lifecycle, and model admission rules explicit.
translations.关系的类型、方向、有效时间、来源与权限共同决定路径是否可用。: Edge type, direction, valid time, source, and permissions jointly determine whether a path is usable.
translations.记录候选、拒绝原因、转换、Omissions、Pack Hash 与评测结果: Record candidates, rejection reasons, transformations, Omissions, Pack Hash, and evaluation results
translations.检索只发现候选；Scope、用途、时态、完整性与信任门禁决定什么能成为证据。: Retrieval only discovers candidates; Scope, purpose, temporal validity, integrity, and trust gates decide what becomes Evidence.
translations.每个槽位都有来源、版本、预算和遗漏规则；Pack 可以保存、重放与评测。: Every slot has a source, version, budget, and omission policy; the Pack can be saved, replayed, and evaluated.
translations.每条绑定 Evidence ID: Each bound to an Evidence ID
translations.秘密与连接属于 Tool Runtime；模型通常只需要抽象后的权限与环境结论。: Secrets and connections belong in Tool Runtime; models usually need only abstracted access and environment facts.
translations.模型只是消费者；选择、授权、时态、证据和预算由运行时负责。: The model is only a consumer; selection, authorization, temporal checks, Evidence, and budgets belong to the runtime.
translations.目标不是塞入更多文字，而是交付最小、可信、及时、授权且可追溯的上下文。: The goal is not to add text, but to deliver the smallest trustworthy, timely, authorized, traceable context.
translations.七类上下文，三个工程平面: Seven context categories across three engineering planes
translations.企业知识调查：确定性治理主干 + 受约束检索推理: Enterprise investigation: deterministic core + bounded retrieval
translations.始终预留回答与修复空间: Always reserve room for response and repair
translations.先按查询形状选择通道，再用证据充分性决定回答、补检索或部分结束。: Choose channels by query shape, then use evidence sufficiency to answer, retrieve gaps, or return a partial result.
translations.真正的产物不是一段答案，而是一条能够被重放的证据决策链。: The real product is not an answer, but a replayable evidence decision chain.
translations.终止 = 证据充分 OR 达到轮数 / 截止时间 / 预算 OR 连续无进展: Stop = evidence sufficient OR round limit / deadline / budget reached OR repeated lack of progress
